# Manifestation Format

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:ManifestationFormat`](gmeow-ManifestationFormat.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/ManifestationFormat>
- **Category:** class
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/creative-works`](../../slices/creative-works.md)
- **Box roles:** [TBox role](../boxes/tbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

The physical or digital format of a [`Manifestation`](gmeow-Manifestation.md) — a VALUE vocabulary (individuals, never subclasses). Hardcover, paperback, EPUB, PDF, audiobook, vinyl, and web-page are examples; the set is open.

## Structure

**Subclass of:** [`gufo:QualityValue`](../../external/terms.md#gufo-qualityvalue)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:ManifestationFormat`](gmeow-ManifestationFormat.md) as a specialized kind of [`gufo:QualityValue`](../../external/terms.md#gufo-qualityvalue). Add statement metadata or a standpoint when the assertion needs provenance, confidence, or vantage.

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use as the value vocabulary for a [`Manifestation`](gmeow-Manifestation.md)'s format — hardcover, EPUB, audiobook, vinyl, web serial; referenced by [`gmeow:hasManifestationFormat`](../properties/gmeow-hasManifestationFormat.md).

### Avoid when

- Avoid minting per-format subclasses of [`Manifestation`](gmeow-Manifestation.md) ([Principle 9](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-9)) and avoid using it for the carrier's material medium (that is [`gmeow:CarrierMedium`](gmeow-CarrierMedium.md)) or the kind of the [`Work`](gmeow-Work.md) ([`gmeow:CreativeWorkType`](gmeow-CreativeWorkType.md)).

### How to use

- Reference a seeded [`gmeow:ManifestationFormat`](gmeow-ManifestationFormat.md) individual from a [`Manifestation`](gmeow-Manifestation.md) via [`gmeow:hasManifestationFormat`](../properties/gmeow-hasManifestationFormat.md); extend with new individuals (not subclasses) when a new format appears.

### Examples

- [`gmeow:formatPaperback`](../individuals/gmeow-formatPaperback.md) a [`gmeow:ManifestationFormat`](gmeow-ManifestationFormat.md).
